name: Beijing 51WORLD Digital Twin Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing 51WORLD Digital Twin Technology Co., Ltd., founded in 2015 and based in Beijing, develops digital twin technology for customers in China and abroad, using 3D graphics, simulation and artificial intelligence. Its offerings include a digital twin SaaS platform, a simulation and synthetic data platform for intelligent driving and robotics called 51Sim, and the 51Earth platform. It serves cities, water conservation and AI uses, and was previously named Host Mobile Green Land.
